question: The bomb squad was called to ______ the explosive device.
solution:
Defuse: Remove the tension (तनाव कम करना)
Diffuse: Spread out; not clear or concise (फैलाना/अस्पष्ट)

question: We had a delicious chocolate cake for ______.
solution:
Desert: An area where there is little rain / To leave someone (रेगिस्तान / त्याग देना)
Dessert: Sweet dish eaten at the end of a meal (भोजन के बाद का मीठा व्यंजन)

question: A new car suffers a rapid ______ in its value during the first year.
solution:
Depression: Hollow / A mental state of despair (गड्ढा/अवसाद)
Depreciation: Undervalue (मूल्य कम होना)

question: A judge must remain completely ______ in his decisions.
solution:
Disinterested: Impartial (निष्पक्ष)
Uninterested: Not interested (दिलचस्पी ना होना)

question: The chef prepared a highly ______ meal for the foreign guests.
solution:
Delightful: Very pleasant (प्रसन्नतादायक)
Delicious: Pleasing to taste (स्वादिष्ट)

question: The strict manager does not ______ any form of indiscipline in the office.
solution:
Deprecate: To hate / disapprove (नापसंद करना)
Depreciate: To reduce in value (मूल्य कम करना)

question: This washing machine is ______; I want to return it.
solution:
Defective: Having a certain imperfection (त्रुटिपूर्ण)
Deficient: Lacking something (कमी होना)

question: The general took a ______ action to win the war quickly.
solution:
Decided: Clear and definite (निर्णय किया हुआ/निश्चित)
Decisive: Deciding (निर्णायक)

question: He is a very ______ worker and always completes tasks on time.
solution:
Effective: Producing effect (असरदार)
Efficacious: Able to produce the desired result (जो निश्चित ही उत्तम परिणाम दे)
Efficient: Competent (कार्यकुशल)

question: The detective tried hard to ______ the truth from the suspect.
solution:
Elicit: To get or produce something (उत्पन्न कर पाना/निकालना)
Illicit: Illegal or disapproved of by society (अवैध)

question: Traveling by bus is much more ______ than taking a private taxi.
solution:
Economical: Involving less expenditure (कम खर्च वाला)
Economic: Relating to economy (अर्थव्यवस्था सम्बन्धित)

question: The pyramids of Egypt are a symbol of ______ architectural beauty.
solution:
Enduring: Existing for a long time (लम्बे समय तक कायम)
Endurable: Bearable (सहन करने लायक)

question: An ______ is a person who leaves his own country to settle in another.
solution:
Emigrant: A person who leaves his country to settle in another (प्रवासी)
Immigrant: One who comes to another country (अप्रवासी)

question: The judge was shocked by the ______ of the horrific crime.
solution:
Enormity: Extreme seriousness (अति, घोर)
Enormousness: Great in size or scale (ज्यादा होना)

question: The delivery company will ______ that your package arrives safely.
solution:
Ensure: To make sure (सुनिश्चित करना)
Insure: To protect against risk (बीमा करना)
Assure: To make certain of (दिलासा देना)

question: Please put the confidential letter inside the sealed ______.
solution:
Envelop: To cover or surround something completely (ढक देना)
Envelope: A flat paper container for a letter (लिफाफा)

question: She loves all kinds of flowers, ______ the red roses.
solution:
Especially: In particular, above all (विशेष कर)
Specially: For a special purpose (किसी विशेष अवसर के लिए)

question: The controversial leader's speech was designed to ______ the mob to violence.
solution:
Excite: To arouse feelings of happiness (उत्तेजित करना)
Incite: To arouse unpleasant or violent feelings (उकसाना / भड़काना)

question: It may be ______ to leave early to avoid the heavy city traffic.
solution:
Expedient: Helpful or useful in a particular situation (सही/ लाभदायक)
Expeditious: Prompt (शीघ्र/ फुर्ती से)

question: Dinosaurs have been ______ for millions of years.
solution:
Extinct: No longer existing (विलुप्त)
Instinct: Inborn impulse (मूल प्रवृत्ति)

question: She has a natural ______ for learning foreign languages quickly.
solution:
Flair: Natural ability (जन्मजात प्रवृत्ति)
Flare: A burst of flame / to become angry (धधकना, फैलना)

question: If you continue to ______ the traffic rules, your license will be suspended.
solution:
Flaunt: Display ostentatiously / to show off (दिखावा करना)
Flout: Disregard a rule or custom (उल्लंघन करना)

question: Finding the lost diamond ring in the park was a purely ______ event.
solution:
Fortuitous: Happening by chance (आकस्मिक)
Fortunate: Lucky (भाग्यशाली)

question: The newly built hospital provides excellent ______ for its patients.
solution:
Felicity: A blessing, happiness (प्रसन्नता)
Facility: Ease or comfort (सुविधा)
Faculty: Ability / college departments (कार्यशक्ति/ कॉलेज के अध्यापकगण)

question: The snake bite proved to be ______ as the man died before reaching the hospital.
solution:
Fatal: Deadly (घातक)
Fateful: Important but with usually negative effect (महत्त्वपूर्ण/ परन्तु नकारात्मक परिणामयुक्त)

question: The child tried to ______ illness to avoid going to school.
solution:
Fain: Gladly (खुशी से)
Feign: To pretend to feel something (दिखावा करना/बहाना बनाना)

question: I accidentally dropped my glass of water on the kitchen ______.
solution:
Floor: The flat surface of room on which we walk (फर्श)
Ground: The surface of earth outside the room (जमीन)

question: The ballet dancer's movements on the stage were incredibly ______.
solution:
Graceful: Handsome or attractive (भव्य)
Gracious: Merciful (दयालु)

question: The old man walked with a slow and unsteady ______.
solution:
Gate: An entrance (द्वार)
Gait: A particular way of walking (चलने का तरीका)

question: He is a true ______ who enjoys fine dining and appreciates perfectly cooked meals.
solution:
Gourmand: A glutton (पेटू)
Gourmet: A food connoisseur (पाक कला का पारखी)

question: I love to ______ to soft classical music while I am studying.
solution:
Hear: To receive sound (सुनना)
Listen: To hear carefully (ध्यान से सुनना)

question: People tend to ______ essential goods in their houses during a crisis.
solution:
Hoard: To store in a secret place (छिपाकर संग्रह करना)
Horde: A large group of people (एक बड़ा समूह)

question: The champion accepted his defeat with great ______ and congratulated the winner.
solution:
Humility: The quality of being humble (विनम्रता)
Humiliation: Disrespect (अपमान)

question: The 15th of August 1947 is a ______ day for India.
solution:
Historic: Important (महत्त्वपूर्ण)
Historical: Relating to history (ऐतिहासिक)
Histrionic: Dramatic and exaggerated (नाटकीय एवं बढ़ा चढ़ाकर)

question: We must show ______ treatment towards stray animals.
solution:
Human: Relating to man (मानव)
Humane: Kind (दयालु)

question: Selling narcotics without a license is completely ______.
solution:
Illegal: Against the law (गैरकानूनी)
Illicit: Disapproved of by society (अवैध)

question: The magician performed an ______ trick that stunned the entire audience.
solution:
Incredible: Unbelievable (अविश्वसनीय)
Incredulous: Not ready to believe something/someone (जो विश्वास न करें)

question: The clever engineer proposed an ______ solution to the complex problem.
solution:
Ingenious: Clever and involving new ideas (बढ़िया एवं नई युक्ति भरा)
Ingenuous: Honest and sincere (निष्कपट, सरल)

question: The critical patient was kept in the ______ care unit.
solution:
Intense: Extreme and forceful (तीव्र)
Intensive: Involving a lot of effort (गहन)

question: Christopher Columbus ______ America, he did not create it.
solution:
Invent: To create something which never existed before (आविष्कार करना)
Discover: To find something for the first time (खोज करना)

question: Ants are known to be very ______ insects, working all day long.
solution:
Industrial: Relating to industry (उद्योग संबंधी)
Industrious: Hard-working (मेहनती)

question: The arrogant king ruled with an ______ attitude, ignoring his people's pleas.
solution:
Imperious: Haughty (दबंग)
Imperial: Majestic, relating to empire (राजसी)

question: It is ______ upon all citizens to pay their taxes honestly.
solution:
Incumbent: To be necessary (जरूरी)
Recumbent: Lying down (लेटा हुआ)

question: She felt highly ______ when she saw her neighbour's brand new luxury car.
solution:
Jealous: Afraid of losing what we love (ईर्ष्यालु - जब वस्तु हमारी हो)
Envious: Wishing we had what others have (ईर्ष्यालु - जब वस्तु हमारी नहीं हो)

question: He made a very ______ decision by saving half his salary for the future.
solution:
Judicial: Relating to a judge or justice (न्याय संबंधी)
Judicious: Wise, Prudent (समझदार)

question: The dry wood will ______ easily and turn to ash in the campfire.
solution:
Light: To start flames to spread light (जलाना-प्रकाशित करने के लिए)
Burn: To start flames to destroy something (जलाना-नाश करने के लिए)

question: The old oak tree was completely destroyed by a bolt of ______ during the storm.
solution:
Lightening: To make bright/pale (उजाला करना/हल्का करना)
Lightning: Flash of bright light in sky (बिजली-आसमान वाली)
Lighting: Arrangement of lights (बिजली की व्यवस्था)

question: I absolutely ______ the bitter taste of that medicine.
solution:
Loath: Reluctant, unwilling (अनिच्छुक)
Loathe: To hate (घृणा करना)

question: If you don't tie the shoelaces tightly, they will remain ______.
solution:
Loose: Not tight (ढीला)
Lose: Be defeated (खोना/हारना)
Loss: State of not in possession (घाटा/हानि)

question: The tropical rainforest is famous worldwide for its thick and ______ vegetation.
solution:
Luxuriant: Strong in growth (प्रचुरता में उगना)
Luxurious: Very comfortable and expensive (विलासितापूर्ण)

question: She is wearing a very ______ pink dress today.
solution:
Lovely: Beautiful (प्यारा, सुंदर)
Lovable: Worthy of love (प्यार करने योग्य)

question: Gold is considered a highly precious ______ all over the world.
solution:
Metal: A chemical element (धातु)
Mettle: Ability (क्षमता)

question: The tailor used a tape to carefully measure one ______ of cloth.
solution:
Metre: A unit of length (लम्बाई की इकाई)
Meter: A device used to measure amount used (एक यंत्र)

question: The reckless driver was heavily fined for his ______ driving on the highway.
solution:
Negligent: Careless (लापरवाह)
Negligible: Very little (नगण्य)

question: Winning the Cricket World Cup was a truly ______ occasion for the entire team.
solution:
Momentary: Short-lived (क्षणिक)
Momentous: Very important (महत्त्वपूर्ण)

question: The shopkeeper refused to sell cigarettes to the boy because he was a ______.
solution:
Minor: Underage (नाबालिग)
Miner: One who works in mines (खदान कर्मी)

question: These harsh tax policies will heavily ______ against the growth of small businesses.
solution:
Militate: To hinder (प्रतिकूल होना)
Mitigate: Make less severe (तीव्रता कम करना/शान्त करना)

question: The country maintains a strong ______ force to protect its sea borders from pirates.
solution:
Naval: Relating to a navy (नेवी संबंधित)
Navel: Central point of abdomen (नाभि)
